said:
I found three small problems in the tests and fixed all three in one commit. All 30 tests pass and the tree is clean.

FOUND 3
- `test/wave.test.js:5`: the test's title still said "exactly 5 in all", but its total check was moved into the next test, so it no longer checks the total. I renamed it to what it checks: 1 spawn at t=0, none half a second later, the next at 1 second. fixed
- `test/game.test.js:129`: the title said "its ghost still dies on the third beam", but the test only checks the tower's `damage` and no ghost is ever hit. I renamed it to say that. fixed
- `test/game.test.js:131`: the test wrote the lantern's damage as a bare `1` (and `2`) instead of reading `LANTERN.damage`, so the same number lived in two places. It now reads `LANTERN.damage` and `LANTERN.damage + 1`. fixed

GATES green (this repo has no Makefile `check-build` target, so I ran `node --test` on the three touched test files, 21/21 passing, then `npm --prefix . run test`, 30/30 passing)
